name: Dab on Darkness!
source:
The darkness inside of you has manifested right before your very eyes!

For once in your life, you get a much needed break, usually you have trouble getting out of bed and struggle with intrusive thoughts from your past that haunt you to this day, however, thanks to a rather pleasant dream you get a rush of positivity and a eager outlook on the day!

Unfortunately for you, the negative emotions that feed on you don't like this at all. Not taking any chances, it decides to manifest itself into a physical form and attempts to have you submit to them. Will you fall to the darkness or rise through it?

Indeed, the strongest enemies we face are often an extension of ourselves, to overcome this adversary, you will have to...

DAB ON DARKNESS!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1332970/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你内心的黑暗，就在眼前化为了实体！

难得一次，你终于得到了亟需的喘息。平时连起床都很困难，过去的念头不由自主地闯入脑海，至今仍纠缠着你。然而，一个愉快的梦让你充满积极情绪，对新的一天也满怀期待！

不幸的是，那些以你为食的负面情绪对此非常不满。为了确保万无一失，它决定化身实体，试图让你臣服。你会沉沦于黑暗，还是奋起穿越它？

的确，我们面对的最强敌人，往往是自身的延伸。要战胜这个对手，你必须……

向黑暗来一记Dab！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1332970/]Steam[/url]]
